cases.title: Corrected restricted-HF ethane C-C stretching: nine basis/mode curves
cases.method: All-electron DF-RHF / def2-universal-jkfit; spherical AO; float64
limitations: Rigid restricted closed-shell RHF stress test; not physical homolytic dissociation or a bond dissociation energy.
Finite-budget local contraction optimization; no proof of global minima.
PySCF independently recomputed fixed-basis energies, not independent contraction optimization or gradient checks.
Some raw frozen-basis structure_id fields retain historical ethane-torsion labels. Join by point index, distance, and exact coordinates using structure-index.json.

relative_energy: E(R)-E(R0), each curve with its own reference at R0=1.5259763767561005 angstrom
